How to list failed pipeline runs
output: tkn pipelinerun list --label 'tekton.dev/pipelineRun=Failed' 2>/dev/null; tkn pipelinerun list --output json | jq '.items[] | select(.status.conditions[0].status == "False") | .metadata.name'

instruction: How to list successful pipeline runs
output: tkn pipelinerun list --output json | jq '.items[] | select(.status.conditions[0].status == "True") | .metadata.name'
